output.explanation:
The central tree retains the generation-to-application flow while shrinking the seed from 102 to 68 lines (33.3%) and from 7,245 to 5,107 characters (29.5%). Five peripheral trees expand pinned inputs, runtime ownership, variant scope, installation retries, and batch preparation. Modular boundaries describe exposed ports and private state; call sequences describe execution; ownership describes retained outputs and sessions; data dependencies explain what each computation requires. Edges attach to the corresponding central concepts using 1-based lines. Positions account for measured text dimensions and leave gaps.

Only context.json and seed.json supplied substantive evidence. Source-grounded qualifications correct overstatements in the seed: diagramEditService.ts passes both versions to apply, but controller enforcement appears only in a comment because its implementation is absent. Retries reuse prepared output within retained service runs; only create explicitly declares requestId idempotency, so duplicate prevention for apply/batch and restart recovery cannot be established here. validatedSubmission.ts asks for correction after rejection and returns a termination flag after acceptance; it does not establish that the model necessarily corrects its output or how the external executor interprets that flag.

Peripheral details absent from the seed include the saved-context session-check exemption and excerpt fallback in diagramEditService.ts; resetting review decisions and selecting only the first requested presentation alternative; explicit-origin reuse across creations; retained maps surviving dispose; model-runtime caching and persisted-message seeding in agentRuntime.ts; accepted submissions surviving a later rejection in validatedSubmission.ts; and provisional child receipts, automatic placement offsets, and indexed errors in diagramBatchService.ts. The supplied files show calls into domain validation/revision publication, but their internal implementations and live canvas mutation semantics are outside the evidence.

diagrams.ascii:
Validated Diagram Generation
|-- DiagramEditService: one retained request owns generation and installation
|   |-- start validates operation, template, scope, variants and context ownership
|   |-- Key = (sessionId, requestId); signature binds input, submission and context hash
|   |   |-- New key -> retain run and AbortController -> generating
|   |   |-- Changed signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   `-- Matching request -> existing state; ambiguous install may be retried
|   `-- get / wait expose cloned state; service retains at most 500 runs
|-- Pin the inputs required to compute a revision
|   |-- Snapshot target and reference revisions; require expected document version
|   |   |-- Anchored target must match the requested current base revision
|   |   `-- Unanchored create at canvas uses temporary [New diagram] context
|   |-- Import exact revisions and node identities; legacy history is a fallback
|   |-- Resolve references to pinned ASCII or checked node excerpts
|   |-- Resolve supplied context or reuse matching bound context for generated edits
|   `-- Request combines instruction, template, references, base, ranges and connections
|-- Produce revisions through the DiagramGenerator boundary
|   |-- Supplied edit -> submitStoredDiagramEdit; no model invocation
|   `-- Generated edit -> generateDiagram(generator, request, options)
|       |-- Check abort and base identity; clone request with base nodeRefs
|       |-- PiDiagramEditRuntime owns a persisted session and submission tool
|       |   |-- Require enabled AI, available model and configured authentication
|       |   |-- Render captured context; resolve imported context sources
|       |   |-- submit_diagram_edit validates candidate, mappings and replacement scope
|       |   |   |-- Rejection returns issues and asks the model to resubmit
|       |   |   `-- Acceptance retains candidate and returns terminate=true
|       |   |-- Require accepted output; revalidate; optionally capture next context
|       |   `-- Finally remove listener, unsubscribe, dispose and untrack session
|       |-- FakeDiagramEditRuntime supplies synthetic output through the same port
|       `-- Check abort -> submitStoredDiagramEdit -> revision before installation
|-- Operation selects the prepared result
|   |-- create-diagram -> fresh IDs; carry next context between counted creations
|   |-- extend-diagram -> origin + selection; validate anchors; create one diagram
|   `-- edit-diagram -> pinned base and resolved replacement ranges
|       |-- In-place -> retain generated ASCII and revision ID
|       `-- Variant -> retain validated reviews and generated revisions
|           |-- Refinement uses the existing review head and saved scope
|           `-- Optional presentation alternative maps owners to generated scopes
|-- Install retained results through versioned canvas ports
|   |-- Edit / variants -> applying -> canvas.apply
|   |   |-- Send stable runId, expectedVersion, original baseRevisionId and revision
|   |   `-- Mutation-time version checks are a stated controller responsibility
|   |-- Create / extend -> applying -> reread latest canvas and place
|   |   |-- Revalidate extension anchors; use origin or position beside anchor
|   |   |-- canvas.create uses runId and latest version; contract is idempotent
|   |   `-- VERSION_CONFLICT -> reread and retry placement, at most 3 attempts
|   |-- Receipt -> completed; record document version, result IDs and next context
|   |   `-- Edit receipts also report unresolved edge IDs
|   `-- Failure and cancellation distinguish preparation from dispatched work
|       |-- Applying + timeout / unavailable / persistence pending -> awaiting-acknowledgement
|       |   `-- Same request, no pending work -> retry installation with retained output
|       |-- VERSION_CONFLICT -> conflict; other errors -> failed
|       `-- Cancel only while generating; dispatched application may have unknown outcome
|-- DiagramBatchService: prepare sequentially, then dispatch one canvas batch
|   |-- Parse direct or generation schema; deduplicate by request key and signature
|   |-- Capture one snapshot; require expectedVersion; reject duplicate diagram edits
|   |-- Child DiagramEditService instances reuse the captured document
|   |   |-- Extra retained revisions require the same document version
|   |   |-- Child apply/create ports collect prepared edits and creations
|   |   `-- Direct submissions bypass generation; child failure prevents dispatch
|   |-- All children complete -> retain application -> applying -> canvas.batch
|   |-- Receipt updates result versions and unresolved edges -> completed
|   `-- Ambiguous application retries the retained batch without regenerating children
`-- Separate reusable helper: runAgentWorkflow
    |-- Validate workflow ID and unique, nonempty step IDs
    |-- before(previous) -> execute(prompt(previous)) -> validate(output, previous)
    |-- Abort checks surround async boundaries; undefined accepted output is an error
    `-- Return final output; executor owns sessions/tools; Pi runtime does not call helper

Pinned inputs and context provenance
|-- resolveReferences uses history first, then the revision registry
|   |-- Require matching revisionId and diagramId
|   |-- Diagram reference -> complete revision ASCII
|   `-- Node reference -> known selection/content node IDs and bounded endLine
|       |-- All IDs are content nodes -> selectionExcerpt
|       `-- Otherwise slice the pinned lines and columns, trimming line ends
|-- Agent context is normalized through AgentContext snapshots
|   |-- Inline context excludes supplied context and context ID; needs llmSessionId
|   |-- Context ID must already be resolved before start
|   |-- Panel session mismatch is rejected when llmSessionId is present
|   |   `-- saved-agent-context- IDs are exempt from this start-time comparison
|   `-- No submission or explicit context on edit -> try bound diagram context
|       `-- Load only when sourceFingerprint matches the current diagram
|-- Prompt rendering consumes captured data
|   |-- JSON: base revision, diagram, editable ranges, options and connections
|   |-- Base revision present -> logical node lines and nodeRefs
|   `-- References and instruction are serialized separately; append output format
`-- Next context must match llmSessionId
    |-- Counted creations feed it into the next generation
    `-- Installation receipt exposes it on the completed run

Runtime boundary and resource ownership
|-- DiagramGenerator hides model execution from DiagramEditService
|   |-- generateDiagram clones the request and supplies stored nodeRefs
|   `-- Submission forwards ASCII, kind, mappings, ranges and nodeCorrespondence
|-- PiAgentRuntime owns model runtime and active session set
|   |-- Lazily cache ModelRuntime.create({ allowModelNetwork: false })
|   |-- Provider: openai-codex; model: override / NEW_DIAGRAM_MODEL / default
|   |-- SessionManager.create(cwd) persists sessions; append imported messages
|   `-- dispose aborts and disposes tracked sessions, then clears the set
|-- PiDiagramEditRuntime configures one custom submit_diagram_edit tool
|   |-- In-memory settings; medium thinking; resolve imported context sources
|   |-- Resource loader disables extensions, skills, templates, themes, context files
|   |-- Tool schema: ASCII 1..200000 chars; kind diagram or tree
|   |   `-- Optional replacement ranges: 1..100; optional mappings: at most 2000
|   |-- Validation uses base, nodeRefs and source-mapping requirement
|   |   `-- Scoped output preserves structure kind and passes scopedReplacements
|   `-- Abort listener forwards abort to session; finally cleans up prompt execution
|-- createValidatedSubmission owns the accepted candidate
|   |-- Rejection -> accepted=false, terminate=false; correction text returned
|   |-- Success -> retain candidate; accepted=true, terminate=true
|   `-- Rejection does not clear an earlier accepted value
`-- runAgentWorkflow is a separate sequencing abstraction
    |-- Feature supplies prompts, before hooks and validators
    |-- Executor receives workflowId, stepId, prompt and signal
    `-- onStepStart precedes before; accepted output becomes next step's previous

Variant scope and review construction
|-- Existing variant must belong to the target diagram
|   |-- Fetch its retained review revisions at the expected canvas version
|   `-- Generate against headRevisionId; preserve the review's original base
|-- Refinement reuses scope rather than accepting new subtree targets
|   |-- Saved replacementScope -> require matching mode and nondeleted ranges
|   `-- Otherwise resolve owner scope -> subnode-single or whole diagram mode
|-- New review owner = selected subtree's logical nodeRef, otherwise root
|   `-- Missing logical owner -> STALE_SUBTREE
|-- Each generated alternative produces a validated DiagramRevisionReview
|   |-- Reuse existing review ID or create a new one
|   |-- Append generated revision ID; update head, name and prompt
|   |-- decisions is reset to an empty object
|   `-- Multi-contiguous / multi-disjoint scope retains generated replacementRanges
`-- Optional presentation alternative
    |-- Targets come from subtrees, subtree, or root
    |-- Parts bind target owner scope to the generated revision's source scope
    `-- selectAlternative is true only for index 0 when selection is requested

Retained output, acknowledgement and placement
|-- Service memory owns request maps, run state and prepared results
|   |-- Matching start retries only awaiting-acknowledgement with no pending work
|   |-- Retain revision, variants or creations; reuse runId for installation
|   |-- No eviction shown; dispose cancels generation without clearing maps
|   `-- Restart recovery and durable request deduplication are not shown
|-- Applying errors determine whether an outcome is uncertain
|   |-- CANVAS_TIMEOUT / CANVAS_UNAVAILABLE / PERSISTENCE_PENDING
|   |   `-- awaiting-acknowledgement; retry installation, never the model
|   `-- VERSION_CONFLICT -> conflict; remaining errors -> failed
|-- Edit installation reuses original expectedVersion and baseRevisionId
|   `-- apply implementation is absent; controller checks are stated in a comment
|-- Creation placement is recomputed against the latest canvas snapshot
|   |-- No origin -> beside anchor; preserve non-root parent placement
|   |-- Automatic horizontal advance = max(1, ASCII line widths) + 6
|   |-- Explicit origin -> same origin for each created diagram; no parentId added
|   |-- Revalidate extension sources; retry version conflict up to 3 attempts
|   `-- Only create explicitly declares idempotency per requestId in the port
`-- Cancellation is available only during generating
    `-- AbortController belongs to the edit run; applying remains observable

Batch preparation and application boundary
|-- One snapshot supplies the document for every sequential child operation
|   |-- Duplicate edit targets are detected by logical diagramId
|   `-- Extra revision fetches must match the captured document version
|-- Fresh DiagramEditService per operation receives collecting canvas ports
|   |-- Child apply appends an edit and returns the captured version
|   |-- Child create appends creations and returns the captured version
|   |   `-- No explicit origin -> accumulate horizontal width + 6 offsets
|   |-- Resolve agentContextId through optional contextFor callback
|   `-- Child requestId = batch runId + operation index
|-- Child completion means preparation succeeded, before live batch dispatch
|   |-- Direct operation supplies edit or diagram to the child
|   |-- Cancellation forwards to the active child and stops dispatch
|   `-- Failure reports operations[index] and prevents final canvas.batch
|-- All children complete -> clear active child -> retain application
|   |-- canvas.batch receives runId, expectedVersion, edits and creations
|   `-- Receipt replaces provisional result versions and unresolved edge IDs
`-- Ambiguous acknowledgement -> resend retained application
    `-- No child regeneration; batch-port deduplication implementation is absent
